description: This line plot illustrates the performance, measured as Micro F1 (%), of four different methods—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval—across four levels of generated sample sizes (K=8, 16, 32, 64). The x-axis, labeled “Number of Samples Generated,” is categorical and displays four discrete values: K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64, with no numerical scale or tick intervals. The y-axis, labeled “Micro F1 (%)”, is linear, ranging from 20 to 52, with major tick marks at intervals of 2 (e.g., 22, 24, ..., 52). The blue line with circle markers (TACRED) starts at approximately 22.5% at K=8, rises to 28% at K=16, peaks at 30.5% at K=32, and then slightly declines to 29.5% at K=64. The orange line with triangle markers (TACRED-Revisit) begins at 23% at K=8, increases to 29.2% at K=16, reaches 31% at K=32, and then decreases to 29.8% at K=64. The green line with diamond markers (Re-TACRED) starts at 34.8% at K=8, rises to 40.3% at K=16, peaks sharply at 50.5% at K=32, and then drops to 47.8% at K=64. The red line with square markers (SemEval) begins at 42% at K=8, increases steadily to 45% at K=16, reaches 47.5% at K=32, and continues rising to 51.5% at K=64. All lines show an overall upward trend from K=8 to K=32, with Re-TACRED and SemEval continuing to improve or plateau at K=64, while TACRED and TACRED-Revisit exhibit slight declines.
